3. identityConsistency - 4: Players maintain their visual identity and team colors consistently across all frames.
4. motionFidelity - 4: Player and ball positions show logical, continuous movement consistent with the source and time gap.
5. sceneFidelity - 4: The stadium background, pitch lines, and advertising boards remain spatially consistent.
6. stylizationStrength - 4: The transformation to a player-focus style is obvious through contrast/sharpening changes and UI removal.
